run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the minimum number of subsets with distinct elements from an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct maximum frequency calculation
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that sorts an array and counts consecutive duplicate elements
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a hash map instead of sorting for maximum frequency
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns the maximum frequency of any element in a given array
